mass.title: Mass analysis
mass.hint: Thousands of matches at once, from each match's summary: no rows are read. Pick a folder of .3dheat files (with its 3dheat-index files, if any).
mass.loaded: {matches} matches: {index} from the index, {cache} cached, {member} from the files, {computed} worked out, {failed} failed · {secs} s · {mb} MB
mass.phases: When in the match (share of its length)
mass.balanceHint: Intervals ~95%; q: false discovery rate against the rest of the split. Click a row to load its matches.
mass.col.name: Name
mass.col.kdTitle: Kills per death, with its ~95% interval
mass.col.winTitle: Share of lives in won matches (rounds), with its Wilson interval
mass.col.qTitle: Benjamini-Hochberg q of K/D and win against the rest
mass.drillTitle: Load these matches into the view, filtered to this
mass.sidesHint: Each side of a map against an even split: matches won where the match names a winner, else lives in won rounds.
mass.chHint.count: Log scale, most in a cell {max}. Click a place to load the map's matches there.
mass.chHint.kd: Kills per death a cell (3 or more), blue low, yellow high. Click a place to load the map's matches there.
mass.chHint.stability: Share of the matches seeing a cell in which it was hot. Click a place to load the map's matches there.
mass.chHint.flow: Presence, with the way it went. Click a place to load the map's matches there.
mass.mapClick: Load the map's matches and look here
mass.insightsHint: Balance, steady hotspots, side advantage, meta shifts and match phases, plus the map detectors on each map's summed grids.
mass.reportLine: {n} findings over {matches} matches, {tests} tests, false discovery rate {fdr}
mass.say.balance.kdUp: {vehicle} trades {ratio}× better than the rest on {where} (K/D {kd}, {units} lives)
mass.say.balance.kdDown: {vehicle} trades {ratio}× worse than the rest on {where} (K/D {kd}, {units} lives)
mass.say.balance.winUp: {vehicle} wins more often than the rest on {where} ({win} of its lives won, odds {ratio}×)
mass.say.balance.winDown: {vehicle} wins less often than the rest on {where} ({win} of its lives won, odds {ratio}× lower)
mass.say.hotspot.stableUp: A steady hotspot on {map}: hot in {share} of the {matches} matches that came by
mass.say.hotspot.stableDown: A place on {map} hot less often than the rest ({share} of {matches} matches)
mass.say.side.winUp: On {map}, side {team} wins {win} of {matches} matches (odds {ratio}× an even split)
mass.say.side.winDown: On {map}, side {team} wins only {win} of {matches} matches (odds {ratio}× below an even split)
mass.say.meta.usageUp: {vehicle} is played more since {since}: {before} → {after} of lives
mass.say.meta.usageDown: {vehicle} is played less since {since}: {before} → {after} of lives
mass.say.phase.peakUp: {event} events crowd into {from}–{to}% of the match length ({ratio}× an even spread)
mass.say.phase.peakDown: {event} events are rare in {from}–{to}% of the match length
